identity_directory.intro: Optional. Keeps this console's user list in step with your identity provider: people exist, with their groups and pre-assigned access, before their first sign-in, and are deactivated when removed there. You don't need this to add users — people appear at their first sign-in.

admin_search.title: Web search
admin_search.intro: A search backend answers {#code}POST /v1/search/\{backend\}{/code} — an authenticated, metering passthrough: the gateway counts the request, attaches the backend's own credential, and forwards the caller's body to the vendor verbatim, returning the vendor's answer verbatim (ADR 0071). Backends are absent from {#code}/v1/models{/code} unless a client asks for them explicitly, so no other client will mistake one for a chat model. Who may search is the grant below; how much they may search is a request ceiling on Quotas.
admin_search.state.none: none yet — add the first one
admin_search.grants_body: One grant per backend — creating the backend made its row. What the caller sends inside the body (a depth, a result count) is the vendor's own pricing, not a decision this screen makes.
admin_search.tiers_empty: No backends yet. Add one above.
admin_search.policy_heading: Which backend each group searches through
admin_search.policy_body: The policy behind {#code}POST /v1/search{/code} (no backend in the path): one request shape in, one answer shape out, through exactly this backend at its default depth. Only backends the group is granted above are offered — a group with none set cannot use the unified route at all.
admin_search.policy_error.title: Could not set the search backend
admin_search.field.vendor_hint: The endpoint and the credential scheme are the vendor's own — configured here, not typed anywhere.
admin_search.field.endpoint_hint: Which of the vendor's documented hosts the searches go to.
admin_search.field.api_key_hint_edit: Leave empty to keep the stored key; tick to remove it.
admin_search.field.api_key_hint_new: Stored encrypted; shown back only as a hint.

match.countPlural=one: Backend deleted — {groups} lost its unified-search policy

match.countPlural=one: Removes the backend and its {n} tier from the gateway outright. Callers of {#code}POST /v1/search/\{backend\}{/code} get "unknown backend" from the next request on, and groups searching through it lose their unified-search policy. This cannot be undone.
match.countPlural=other: Removes the backend and its {n} tiers from the gateway outright. Callers of {#code}POST /v1/search/\{backend\}{/code} get "unknown backend" from the next request on, and groups searching through it lose their unified-search policy. This cannot be undone.

admin_search.delete.spend_note: Recorded spend is unaffected: past searches keep their attribution in the ledger.
